test_cases.name: happy_path_unanimous_consensus_commit
test_cases.description: Full lifecycle execution where all registered validators vote VOTE_COMMIT, leading to successful atomic commit, post-write checksum verification, and shadow buffer cleanup.
test_cases.input: Initialize 2PC transaction TXN-2026-001 for proposed refactor targeting auth_service.py and token_helper.py with validators linter-1, syntax-check, and unit-tests.

test_cases.name: single_validator_rejection_triggers_abort
test_cases.description: When any validator emits VOTE_ABORT due to syntax or test failures, unanimous consensus fails, immediately aborting the transaction and purging staging buffers with zero dirty writes.
test_cases.input: Execute 2PC transaction TXN-2026-002 where validator security-scanner returns VOTE_ABORT with SQL_INJECTION_DETECTED.

test_cases.name: validator_timeout_triggers_abort
test_cases.description: If any validator exceeds the configured timeout threshold during Phase 1, the transaction halts immediately with VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT and aborts.
test_cases.input: Execute 2PC transaction TXN-2026-003 where validator integration-tests hangs and exceeds 30000ms timeout.
expected_output_patterns: [VALIDATOR_TIMEOUT] Validator did not respond within 30000 ms

test_cases.name: staging_isolation_verification_before_commit
test_cases.description: Verifies that production disk files remain completely pristine and unaltered while proposed mutations are evaluated inside the shadow staging buffer.
test_cases.input: Execute Phase 1 prepare for transaction TXN-2026-004 and verify target files on disk match baseline checksums before any commit.

test_cases.name: atomic_write_failure_recovery_and_cleanup
test_cases.description: If a filesystem write error or checksum mismatch occurs during Phase 2 flush, all written files are rolled back to pristine baseline backups and transaction aborts.
test_cases.input: Simulate disk write error during Phase 2 flush for transaction TXN-2026-005.

test_cases.name: empty_validator_registry_precondition_rejection
test_cases.description: Attempting to initialize a 2PC transaction without registered validators fails pre-flight validation immediately with PRECONDITION_FAILED.
test_cases.input: Attempt to register 2PC transaction with empty validator list.
